name: Cargo downloaded crates
description: The compressed .crate files Cargo downloaded from the registry. Cargo downloads again what a build needs, so the cost is bandwidth, and a build with no network will fail until they are back. Extracted sources (registry/src), installed tools (~/.cargo/bin), git checkouts and Cargo's settings are NOT touched: the extracted sources are deliberately left alone, because a half-removed crate directory breaks builds and does not recover. Only Cargo's default location is covered: a CARGO_HOME elsewhere is not followed.
